events.text:
I found 85 likely duplicate pairs and did not merge any. Merges move all orders and invoices to the surviving record and delete the other record, and they cannot be undone. A general cleanup request is not enough authorization for that.

- **73 pairs** match on name, address, and tax ID (example: C-1001 / C-1440, Pellham Industrial). These look like true duplicates.
- **12 pairs** match on name and address but have different tax IDs (example: C-2210 / C-2875, Ridgeview Holdings, 41-0091822 / 41-0091950). These may be separate legal entities, so I would not merge them without a review of each pair.

Full list: `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`.

Confirm if I should merge only the 73 exact matches, and which record to keep (I would keep the lower customer ID unless you say otherwise). I will leave the 12 tax-ID mismatches untouched until you decide.
